name: B2B WhatsApp Outreach Engine - Singapore F&B (Supabase + AI + WA API)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    lead_id,
    name,
    clean_name,
    category,
    address,
    phone,
    website,
    instagram_url,
    rating,
    review_count,
    lead_priority
FROM v_n8n_pending_whatsapp 
LIMIT 15;

values.content: You are a friendly, professional B2B Sales Executive from 'Juragan by Anak Bawang' (Boyolali, Central Java). Write a warm, concise (under 80 words) WhatsApp message in Indonesian/English to a restaurant manager in Singapore offering a complimentary 1kg sample box of authentic Boyolali Fried Shallots (Grade S Murni 100% & Grade A Crispy, Halal ID33110018517710724). Return valid JSON with key "wa_message".

parameters.query:
=UPDATE b2b_leads
SET 
    status_whatsapp = 'sent',
    wa_sent_count = wa_sent_count + 1,
    last_contacted_at = NOW(),
    ai_generated_pitch = '{{ $json.message.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}';

=INSERT INTO b2b_outreach_logs (
    lead_id, 
    channel, 
    recipient, 
    subject, 
    message_body, 
    status
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.lead_id }}',
    'whatsapp',
    '{{ $json.phone }}',
    'WhatsApp Direct Outreach',
    '{{ $json.message.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    'sent'
);
